precepts.text: The smoke out of the bottomless pit is Europe, and the sun darkened by it is the destruction.
precepts.point: The destruction coming to America means the rebirth of the Israelite man and woman ruling on the earth, and that is what makes it a problem.

precepts.why: Ezra saw the same missiles John saw: fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, and they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn. The flying swords is making reference to these missiles that Revelation 9 is making reference to, their tails like unto serpents, and with their heads they do hurt.

Everything we are looking at is all in the Most High's hands. The Lord is angry now, and he is getting ready to bring serious devastation to deliver his people out of Egypt, out of the bondage, with a mighty hand. “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire,” The smith is the blacksmith, a man that made weapons; the Lord said, I created that thing. Blowing the coals in the fire is to make the steel hot so you can bend it and shape it and make swords, shields, bucklers, battle axes, weapons of war. “and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work;” He is going to cause this smith to bring forth an instrument for his work, and his work is to deliver the Israelites. “and I have created the waster to destroy.” The waster is the instrument he caused these smiths to make: that is what you were just looking at on the screen, the nuclear bomb. God caused the smith to create that, and they are not going to be able to stop it. The Most High is going to cause them to use those weapons on each other while he delivers us. That is what Revelation is talking about: he is going to deliver us up while the bombs are coming; ten thousand on one side, you are going to see people dying, like Psalms 91: only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. He created the waster to destroy the enemies.

“No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper;” No weapon that is formed against the children of Israel shall prosper. The Most High said it shall not come nigh thee; that goes back to Psalms 91: destruction shall come, a thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. “and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn.” The Most High means business. So we have nothing to worry about, brothers and sisters. The Lord is our power, the Lord is our shepherd, and we ain't going to lack nothing. Keep your minds up.

These nations that remain alive are not going to repent. “Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth” That is what we just read about. “to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus;” That is Lebanon. “to turn themselves one against another,” They are going to fight: World War III. “and repay the things that they have done to them.” Repay the things they have done to the Israelites; the next verse explains it: “Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Thus saith the Lord God; My right hand shall not spare the sinners,” See what the Lord said: his right hand will not spare the sinners; Christ will not spare the sinners. “and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth. The fire is gone forth from his wrath, and hath consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled. Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! saith the Lord.” Woe to them that sin and keep not my commandments. That touches our people for a moment: 2 Peter 2 speaks of them.

Woe to them that sin and keep not my commandments; this touches our people just for a moment. “These are wells without water,” Peter gives an analogy about Israelites. You go to a well to get water because you are thirsty, but there is no water in the well. So you have brothers and sisters who appear like they have knowledge, water, understanding, but when you examine them they are wells without water; you see a lot of them on YouTube today. “clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.” Meaning what? There are certain spirits that are reserved for evil. They come into this truth as brothers, as sisters, but in the end they were reserved for evil. That is what that darkness is.

“For when they speak great swelling words of vanity,” Great swelling words of BS, of lies; it is talking about Israelites now. “they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.” Like Deacon Malachi brought out today: a brother who has been here for some time sees a dumb video that went up in December of last year, and he goes, I've been tricked, I've been fooled, I'm leaving. Evil. Those spirits, and there ain't too many of them, reach out to brothers and sisters that do not apply Romans 16:17, mark them which cause divisions and avoid them. Some of you men and women say, I don't have to obey that, you can't tell me who to talk to. Okay, and this is what happens: they allure you, draw you into their BS, their lies, their evil, through much wantonness, sexual evil, spiritually speaking. Those that were clean escaped from them: that is those of you that remained behind, but you kept entertaining it, listening to them. They were my friends, I'm not cutting them off, I'm not obeying Romans 16:17; I know Christ said if your right hand offend you, cut it off, but I'm not obeying Christ either.

“While they promise them liberty,” They promise you liberty: come with us, you don't have to do what they say, they're not the men of the Lord, come to my house and sit with me and we'll start all over again. Here it is almost a year later: they have not taught one thing on the street, they have not traveled anywhere, they have done absolutely nothing. A brother that was with us left and said, you don't have to go on the street and teach any more. What scripture was that? He didn't have one. Those spirits fool some of you men and women. And this incident here: it is not so much the brother, it is that he is weak; his wife stayed in contact with the wives of the idiots that left, they got in her head, and because he is weak she got in his head. That damn pillow talk: right after you have sex you want to have a conversation. Don't talk to me, I'm tired, go to sleep. But not this brother: let's cuddle, you need to be more affectionate, and she is in his ear, they're wicked, they're evil, we need to go do nothing in the world with the rest of those men and women who love the Lord. He started off good, doing work in Haiti and all that; now look at him doing nothing with his damn buzzard wife. Wicked as hell, but shame on you. The fools that leave this truth promise you liberty: those commandments are a burden, keeping the Sabbath is a burden, you only have to observe the Sabbath from sunup to sundown. Yeah, that's easier, I can go shopping Friday night, I can go to the club Friday night. “they themselves are the servants of corruption:” Those men and women that left this truth are servants of corruption, servants of sin. “for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.” Into bondage of sin. Peter was warning us, because it happened back then during the time of the apostles, and it is happening all over again.

“For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world” You came into this truth, you struggled, you fought to escape the sins of the world. “through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ,” How do you escape the sins of this world? Through the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ: he gives us the laws, the commandments; he teaches us where sin begins, in our minds and our thoughts, and we have to start to curb our thinking. “they are again entangled therein,” Because you were listening to them fools that left this truth, you are again entangled, “and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.” It is worse with you now than when you first came in. When you first came in you only struggled with porn or weed; now you left the truth and it is all kinds of evil, everything you can think of. “For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.” All those men and women that heard this truth, came in, learned, applied, prayed, saw the benefits of the truth, lives changed, marriages held together through counsel, through the scriptures; now they go, I just hate you, I'm leaving, they're all hate groups. It had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness.

“But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.” The sow is the pig, and the mire is mud: you washed the pig and it went right back to the mud you washed off it; the dog vomited, then went back and licked it up again. That is every man and woman that left this truth. I don't care if they are on Facebook with fringes on: they are wicked as hell, all of them, every last one of them. Why? Because the evil they said happened in Austin, they put it on everybody: you're all wicked, all the leadership, you all did it. But we are all the way in another part of the country; we don't know what the hell is going on over there. That shows improper judgment. Every last one of them.

“I will not spare them:” Wait a minute, what did God say? I will not spare them. So you are wasting your time praying for these sinners; God said I will not spare them. “go your way, ye children, from the power,” Meaning get the hell out of here. “defile not my sanctuary.” Why? Because you had Israelites in the midst of sin, so God said to them, go from here, do not defile my sanctuary. You may say, but we don't have the sanctuary today. Really? Ezekiel 11:16 says the Lord is to us a little sanctuary in the countries where we are scattered. Leave the school, leave the truth: that is what this verse is saying. This is one of the small sanctuaries God has set up, and he is saying, get out. It is the same thing that happened during the time of the apostles: they went out from us, but they were not of us (1 John 2:19).

We don't have the sanctuary today? Then what is this talking about? “Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen,” We are scattered throughout America, Africa, India, Central and South America, the Caribbean islands. “and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.” In all the countries God said, I will be to them a little sanctuary. We will have small schools. This is little right here; you might think this is big, but God says this is little, because the Bible says we number the sand of the sea.

It is the same thing Ezra prophesied: it happened during the time of the apostles and it is happening today. “Little children, it is the last time:” These are the last days. “and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists;” John said even now there are many antichrists, many people against the Son of God. “whereby we know that it is the last time.” That is how you know these are the last days.

“They went out from us, but they were not of us;” They went out from us, because they were in the midst of sin, and they did videotapes, recordings, to lure out the rest of the simple. That is why God said in Esdras, leave from my sanctuary, and I will not spare you on that day. Who wrote this? The apostle John. When people leave the truth they are not still in the truth. “for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us:” If they had been of us in this truth they would have still been with us, holding the line. It is us against the world, brothers and sisters: here we are on the battlefield and these men and women leave. They are not of Christ; the Bible says they are antichrist. Don't you realize that the spirit of Christ is about unity? That knucklehead in North Carolina did the same thing: we are on the battlefield and he just jumps up and runs. But they all say, I'm still in the truth. No, you're not. Then he sends links to people in the congregation to watch that abomination; they want men and women to fall out of this truth. They will never say I hate God, I hate Christ; they say I'm against the leadership, they're evil. Who else on this earth is doing the work we are doing? Looking all through YouTube, traveling and looking, it is only us. So you are going to turn from this and go sit in some room with an idiot eating cheese doodles? “but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.” They went out from this truth that they might be made manifest. The deceit is they all say, I'm still in the truth, look, I wear fringes, look how cute me and my family look. They went out that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us. That is the same precept that goes with many are called, but few are chosen.

When the spirit of God says gather yourselves together, it means that; Paul said the same thing here. If you read this and then separate, you have the devil on you, you antichrist. “Endeavouring to keep the unity” What is that word? Unity. You are going to leave this gospel, leave the brothers and sisters that laboured with you? “of the Spirit in the bond of peace.” The bond of peace. “There is one body, and one Spirit,” One body, and one Spirit. So how are you going to separate, I'm going to do my own thing? You are not in the spirit of Christ; I don't know what Bible you are reading. “even as ye are called in one hope of your calling; One Lord, one faith, one baptism, One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.” Those are the ones that have that singleness of mind, heart and soul, those that are about unity. When you separate from that spirit of unity, that spirit of Christ, you are not about unity; you are not about gathering the nation of Israel at all.

“For the Lord knoweth all them that sin against him,” You have men and women that say, oh, you didn't catch me in any sin, I'm just leaving. What we can't see behind the curtain, the Lord sees; there is a reason behind it all. And one of the first sins they did was leaving the sanctuary: to hell with y'all. “and therefore delivereth he them unto death and destruction.” This is the Bible; it can't be changed. We may have people who say, but I really liked that brother, that sister, and he had such cute children. There is nothing we can do now to change what this verse says.

“For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth” Now them plagues have come upon the whole earth. We read about one plague tonight, the locusts, and those locusts are the planes that were gunning everybody down during World War I and World War II. “and ye shall remain in them: for God shall not deliver you,” Now this scares me: for God shall not deliver you. I want to be delivered. “because ye have sinned against him.” You think you are offending us; what you do is not against us, it is against God. When you say to hell with them, to hell with IUIC, they're a hate group, that is not against us, it is really against God, because there is no other organization on earth doing what God has us doing.

“Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east:” What is happening in the east? Here is a prophecy. “Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots,” The Arabs are going to come out with many chariots. This is a prophecy. “and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” Here it comes: “Also the Carmanians” Write that down: the Carmanians are the Iranians. This is a prophecy about the Arabs and Iran. “raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood,” The wild boars: there is Ishmael again; that is the part letting you know it is talking about Ishmael. “and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.” That is around Syria and Turkey. Your president, Donald J. Trump, just murdered one of the generals in Iran, and Iran is mad as hell. For the first time in history the red flag has been unfurled over the holy dome of the Jamkaran mosque in Qom, Iran; the flag is a symbol of war, a symbol of a severe battle to come, raised in honour of Qassem Soleimani, who was killed by the American air strikes. This is happening right now. So for you to see this stuff and read the scripture and say, I'm going to leave the truth: you're an idiot. If you have a problem with your brother or your sister, this is the time to work it out, make it right, not use it as an excuse to leave. And you women, curse out your husbands if you want, and don't think you are going to be saved; don't think God is such an idiot. You men that do evil things, don't think the Lord is going to deliver you. He said all the sinners of my people shall die. What just happened is huge: a lot of the Arab world said nothing, but they are seeing it: if America can kill this guy, the second most powerful man in Iran, like killing the vice president of the United States. This is going to hurt America for a long time. He told all the Americans to leave the Middle East, and sent 25,000 troops. Iranians in the United States are pissed the hell off right now. Brothers and sisters online, this has nothing to do with us; stay in the scriptures. When you see this thing, the scripture says our salvation is near. Do not do anything stupid; don't say anything stupid either. You can pop a bottle, have a drink, and stay in the scriptures. Even some European countries and Trump's own allies separated themselves from what he did. The SPLC is labeling us as terrorists, and Trump just unleashed real terrorists; wait till them real terrorists get loose in this country. The Bible calls them caterpillars.

“And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature;” Their nature is in Genesis 16:11-12: Ishmael will be a wild man. Why are we being so docile, Habib? That is not in our nature. Like a lion taken out of the jungle, where God put him, and domesticated: one day the lion wakes up and says, what the hell am I doing here, jumping through fire? That is not my nature. Like the elephant sitting on a stool that recognized it and went crazy, running the kids all over the place. Same thing with the Arabs: one day they are going to wake up and say, wait a minute, peace? We were never a people about peace. Why are we signing contracts with America? That is not our nature. That is when the boom starts. “and if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them,” Conspiring together: you have many Arab nations and a lot of them are divided, and what America is doing is going to unite them, because they are going to realize we can't fight America by ourselves; we need to unite with our other Arab brothers and sisters. That is what the Bible says. This ain't hate speech; this is truth, this is prophecy. So don't sleep. This is why they don't want this word to get out there: the prophets are back, and we're black.

When you see this thing, the scripture says our salvation is near. “And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations,” We are seeing distress of nations right now. “with perplexity;” Confusion. “the sea and the waves roaring;” Meaning nations getting angry. “Men’s hearts failing them for fear,” That is why Americans are running the hell out of the Middle East now. “and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth:” There are going to be a lot more things happening on this earth. “for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.” When it says the powers of heaven shall be shaken, that means war. “And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.” Christ is coming in the midst of the war.

“And when these things begin to come to pass,” What should we do? “then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.” Give the Lord a hand for that thing. So don't be afraid, don't be scared. We are supposed to look up and know that our redemption is near.

The dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature. Let's get their nature. “And the angel of the Lord said unto her,” To Hagar. “Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael;” Ishmaelite, in the Zondervan Bible dictionary: the word is used in the Old Testament in a wider sense, referring to the nomadic tribes of northern Arabia generally, and all Arabs, following Muhammad's example, that is Islam, claim descent from Ishmael. So they know who they are. “because the Lord hath heard thy affliction.” That is what Ishmael means: affliction heard.

“And he will be a wild man;” The Bible says the descendants of Ishmael shall be wild. How wild? They are willing to strap C4 on their bodies, and not just the men: now they have the women doing it, children doing it, blowing everything to hell and back. That is how wild they are. You better run the hell out of there. “his hand will be against every man,” See that: his hand will be against every man. Black people in America think, oh, this is my friend Habib. No, no: they are for one cause, and they are willing to sacrifice everybody for their religion. “and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.” That is that area they call the Middle East. So in 2 Esdras 15:30, as the wild boars of the wood: there are the Arabs again, there is Ishmael again.

The bottomless pit is Europe. “But now they that are younger than I have me in derision”: they that are younger than I is Esau. Younger than I means less than us; although Esau came out first, the elder shall serve the younger, and we are the chosen, God’s heirs. “Whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock”: the prophet Job is saying they weren’t good enough to sit with his dogs. “Fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste”: this tells you the time. “They were driven forth from among men”: this particular race was driven forth from among men. You look for Neanderthals and cavemen nine million years ago; this is talking about the Dark Ages. In the time of Genesis, Esau was the first dukes of Edom and they were rich, so this is another time period. “(They cried after them as after a thief;)”: we drove them from society like they stole something. “To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks”: the Caucasus mountains of Georgia and Russia, that area of Europe. Europe has very few resources and minerals; that’s why they go to places like Africa to get them. The caveman was not in the time of Genesis; Job was prophesying something that was to come. “They were children of fools, yea, children of base men”: the lowest men on earth. “They were viler than the earth.”
A precept to show you this is war; he uses the same wording about destruction. “And, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace”: Sodom and Gomorrah had just been destroyed.

One of the plagues of Egypt mentioned locusts, but there is a difference between the locusts of Exodus 10 and the locusts of Revelation 9. “That they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left”: see what locusts do. “And there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field.”
“And smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof”: Esdras was during the Persian captivity, so Esdras ain’t talking about ancient Egypt.

Who got sealed with the seal of God: “And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” The nations these locusts make reference to don’t have the seal of God.
What that seal is: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.”

Paul discussed the seal too. “I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts”: the law going into our mind is what being sealed is. The men that don’t have the seal of God are these other nations, the locusts.

What Daniel said about this, all of which occurred between World War I and World War II. “And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south”: the king of the south was the Ptolemies. “Also the robbers of thy people”: in the time of Christ you had the Herodians, Agrippa, certain families who had converted to what is called Judaism today. “Shall exalt themselves to establish the vision”: now we got the home, this is our homeland, we the Jews. “But they shall fall”: that’s the prophecy. No matter what they do to Israel, the scripture says they shall fall. This ain’t hate speech; we love to read the Bible.

“There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea”: how was Herod the king of Judah? The Zondervan Bible dictionary calls the Herods Idumean rulers of Palestine, and Idumean means pertaining to Edom. Herod was an Edomite. Antipater was made procurator of Judea by Julius Caesar; they made this Edomite, Herod the Great, king of the Jews. His son Herod Antipas killed John the Baptist and was called a fox by Christ, and when you called somebody a fox in them days, that was an insult. Herod Agrippa I killed James the apostle, and Paul appeared before Herod Agrippa II.

This is the Agrippa that Paul met; he was an Idumean, a convert to what they call Judaism. “Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews”: how was Herod an expert in our customs? Because he went to the schools we had set up.

“And Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul”: these Israelites were brought up with Herod the tetrarch and Saul, whom we call Paul today; they all went to the same school. Herod was in our school to learn our customs and our language and answer the questions among the Jews. That made the Herodians better vassals of Rome, to sit on the throne and govern us.
“The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.”
“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time”: we are in that period right now.

We went over this a few months ago. “And the water thereof was dried up”: there are dams set up along it in recent times, and Ethiopia and Egypt are at odds over those dams. “That the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” “And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon”: that is politics, democracy and republicanism (Revelation 13:11-13). “And out of the mouth of the beast”: an economic system, the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund, both run from Washington DC; you got to follow America’s policies to do world business (Revelation 13:16-18). “And out of the mouth of the false prophet”: Christianity (Revelation 13:14-15). “For they are the spirits of devils”: politics, economics and Christianity are the three things that cause nations to go to war, because devils set all three systems up. Sierra Leone has diamond mines everywhere but their money is garbage; the IMF and the World Bank dictate that, and they do that through the entire continent of Africa, taking the gold and diamonds to Europe and America. “To gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.”

About this huge army. “Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus”: Libanus is Lebanon. “To turn themselves one against another”: this hasn’t happened yet; that is what the sixth angel sounding at the Euphrates is about. “And repay the things that they have done to them.” Who is them? “Like as they do yet this day unto my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom.” Black people in church say we got to pray that there’s no war. No; God said I’m doing this for what they did to my chosen, the Israelites. We are on the brink of it now, in the starting stages, so you would be a fool to pray against it. If a missile comes and I get killed, I’m going to get raised again.
Who is God’s chosen? “O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.”

points: Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates. Them four angels are the armies of the earth with their weapons, prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men: two and a half billion people.
In that year there is a month, in that month there is a day, and in that day there is an hour when all of Babylon's plagues come on her. It will take the nations one hour to destroy this whole land.
The number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: two hundred million soldiers.

The prophet saw a vision of a modern military and explained it as best he could. Horses with heads as the heads of lions, out of their mouths fire and smoke and brimstone: that is tanks. Their power is in their mouth and in their tails, their tails like unto serpents, with heads, and with them they do hurt: that is missiles flying, and the warhead is where the hurt is. Some warheads are nuclear. What he is seeing is a world war, that army that kills the third part of men.

The rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands: they will not stop worshiping devils and idols. The white Jesus image is worshiping the devil. Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts: neither of the lands they stole. When Christ returns, they will come to fight against him.

One woe is past; there come two woes more hereafter: World War I and World War II. The sixth angel sounded: Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates. That is what we just read. What are those angels doing over there? Holding back World War III, that third war. And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men. And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand.

Look up a third of eight billion: in this war, a third of the earth, about two and a half billion people, will die. This is before Christ even starts his judgment. And after that war they still have to come and fight against Christ. There will be a build-up to that war when those angels are loosed, and the finale of it is America destroyed in one hour.

points: Some bad news first: a phone call out of Montreal. A soldier stepped out of his house with his daughter in his car, two guys pulled up, a black guy and an Arab guy, asked him, are you prophesying? He said yes, and they shot him twice. His name is soldier Oliel; keep him in your prayers. We have been hearing in the media this term radicalizing, that a person can watch a video and become radicalized, and that is what they are trying to say about the person that visited one camp four years ago, painting all of Israel as connected to that situation that happened in New Jersey.

“By these three was the third part of men killed,” By these three were the sons of the wicked killed. He is going to name the three: “by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.” Because in their mouths is the warhead.

“For their power is in their mouth,” That is what a nuclear warhead is. “and in their tails:” That is the propulsion, the fire that pushes the missile, the propulsion fuel. “for their tails were like unto serpents,” That is how John looked at it: when he saw these missiles flying, he said their tails are like serpents. “and had heads, and with them they do hurt.” With their heads they do hurt. Look at the diagram of a missile's parts: upper stage guidance, payload, warhead, explosive bolts, detonators, rocket motor engines, arm fire devices, ignition safety devices, boost motor separation systems, thrust termination systems, control actuation system, launcher, separation nuts. What the Bible is describing: you have the warhead and the guidance part at the front, and then you have the launcher, the tail. Watch a rocket and missile launch, the daylight scene: you see the tails; they had tails like serpents, and with their heads they do hurt. That is what John saw in the spirit. Ezra saw the same thing: fire, and hail, and flying swords, and they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows (2 Esdras 15:40-42); flying swords is making reference to these missiles that Revelation 9 is making reference to.

John the Revelator is seeing war, glimpses of World War, and then from verse 13 down, with the sixth angel, he sees the final third world war, what we call the third world war; the Bible calls it the battle of Armageddon. We are definitely in biblical times, last-day biblical times. The scripture says to lift our heads up when we see these things begin to draw near, because our redemption draweth nigh. This is not the time to get fainthearted, to start worrying; this is what we were built for. We are coming out of Egypt, out of captivity, and the Lord is getting ready to send his holy angels, his chariots, to get us out of here. Through much tribulation shall we enter into the kingdom; he that endureth unto the end shall make it. It is going to take great power to break the slaveholder from keeping his slaves; they are not going to let the Israelites go easy, not just let you walk out of prison. It is going to take war, and that is what we are reading about. In 2 Esdras 15 God said he would send the plagues of Egypt back, but on a higher level than what we saw in Egypt: the locusts, the waters turned to blood, the star that hits the waters so they become as wormwood. Look at these plagues with spiritual eyes.

All of this is in the Most High's hands. The Lord is angry now and is getting ready to bring serious devastation to deliver his people out of Egypt, out of bondage, with a mighty hand. I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and I have created the waster to destroy (Isaiah 54:16): God caused the smith to create the nuclear bomb, and the Most High is going to cause them to use those weapons on each other while he delivers us. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper (Isaiah 54:17): that goes back to Psalms 91, a thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee; only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked. The Most High means business, so we have nothing to worry about. The Lord is our power, the Lord is our shepherd, and we ain't going to lack nothing. Keep your minds up.

“And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues” Because everybody over there ain't going to get killed; everybody in the military ain't dying. “yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:”

“Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.” So these nations that remain alive are not going to repent. God said he will call together all the kings of the earth to turn themselves one against another, World War III, and repay the things they have done to the Israelites; his right hand shall not spare the sinners, and woe to them that sin and keep not my commandments (2 Esdras 15:20-24). And that touches our people: wells without water, clouds carried with a tempest, to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever (2 Peter 2:17-22), brothers and sisters who appear to have knowledge but are empty, certain spirits reserved for evil that come into this truth and in the end are made manifest. Those that leave promise you liberty, you don't have to keep those commandments, the Sabbath is only sunup to sundown, but they are the servants of corruption, and the latter end is worse with them than the beginning: the dog turned to his own vomit, the sow washed to her wallowing in the mire. God said of them, I will not spare them: go your way, ye children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary (2 Esdras 15:25), and he is to us a little sanctuary in the countries where we are scattered (Ezekiel 11:16); these small schools are the sanctuary. They went out from us, but they were not of us, John said; even now there are many antichrists (1 John 2:18-19): the spirit of Christ is about unity, one body and one Spirit (Ephesians 4:3-6), and when you separate from that you are not in the spirit of Christ. The Lord knoweth all them that sin against him, and delivereth them unto death and destruction; now are the plagues come upon the whole earth, and ye shall remain in them, for God shall not deliver you (2 Esdras 15:26-27). Then the horrible vision from the east: the nations of the dragons of Arabia coming out with many chariots, and the Carmanians, the Iranians, raging in wrath as the wild boars of the wood, wasting a portion of the land of the Assyrians, around Syria and Turkey, and the dragons having the upper hand, remembering their nature, conspiring together (2 Esdras 15:28-31). This is a prophecy about the Arabs and Iran, and it is happening right now: Donald Trump just murdered one of the generals in Iran, Qassem Soleimani, and for the first time in history the red flag, a symbol of war, of a severe battle to come, was unfurled over the holy dome of the Jamkaran mosque in Qom. What just happened is huge; a lot of the Arab world says nothing, but they are seeing it: if America can kill this guy, the second most powerful man in Iran. Trump told all the Americans to leave the Middle East and sent 25,000 troops there. Iranians in the United States are pissed the hell off right now. Brothers and sisters, this has nothing to do with us; stay in the scriptures, do not do anything stupid, don't say anything stupid, because when you see this thing, our salvation is near: when these things begin to come to pass, look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh (Luke 21:25-28). Christ is coming in the midst of the war. Some European countries and even Trump's allies separated themselves from what he did. The SPLC labels us as terrorists, and Trump just unleashed real terrorists; wait till them real terrorists get loose in this country. The Bible calls them caterpillars. Ishmael's nature: he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man (Genesis 16:11-12); all Arabs, following Muhammad's example, claim descent from Ishmael, so they know who they are. Like a lion taken out of the jungle and domesticated, one day he wakes up: that is not my nature. The Arab nations are divided, but what America is doing is going to unite them: we can't fight America by ourselves. This ain't hate speech; this is truth, this is prophecy. So don't sleep. That is why they don't want this word to get out: the prophets are back, and we're black. And the brother that was shot, Oliel Micahiah Israel, texted: the word needs to be spread and the acts of the apostles need to continue no matter what; I'm going to be fine.
“And I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth”: this star refers to an angel. “And to him was given the key of the bottomless pit”: that him is the star. The bottomless pit is Europe.

“And there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit”: this is talking about war. Verse 2 lets us know that war is in session; now we want to find out what war it is talking about.

“And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth”: these locusts make reference to planes. This is making reference to World War I. “And unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power”: a scorpion stings you from its tail, from the rear. Behind the pilot sat the rear gunner, who shot from the rear of the plane; that’s how these planes operated.

“And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree”: don’t locusts eat grass, green things and the leaves on trees? These are not real locusts; John is talking about something that looked like locusts. “But only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads”: the locusts are the nations of World War I: Germany, Austria-Hungary, Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire, against Great Britain, France, Russia, Italy, Romania, Japan and the United States of America. These nations don’t have the seal of God. During World War I the British government issued the Balfour Declaration in 1917, announcing support for a national home for the Jewish people in Palestine; a homeland for European people who were converts to what was called Judaism. It was addressed to Lord Rothschild; Roth is German for red, and child is shield, red shield. The zionists and all those nations don’t have the seal of God in their foreheads.

“That they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months”: World War I lasted from 1914 to 1918, a five-year war; the five months make reference to five years. “And their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man”: the gunner was in the rear of the plane.
“And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it”: about 20 million soldiers were injured, lamed, who did not die. A lot of people died, but this goes to those that were wounded.

“And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle”: a horse prepared for battle has on armour, and these planes were made out of metal. “And on their heads were as it were crowns like gold”: their helmets, as they reflected the sun, were like gold. “And their faces were as the faces of men”: John is looking at men’s heads sticking out of the tops of the planes. He had never seen anything like this before; he is trying to describe it the best he could.

“And they had hair as the hair of women”: the long scarves they wrapped around their necks as they flew, flowing in the back; a yellow scarf looks like blonde hair. “And their teeth were as the teeth of lions”: the teeth they painted on the sides of the planes. Those planes came about at the beginning of World War II, so John is looking at an amalgamation of things happening with war. The Balfour Declaration of 1917 had not yet given them their homeland; after World War II, on 14 May 1948, the State of Israel was proclaimed by David Ben-Gurion, and they brought Europeans there, zionists who practised Judaism, converts. This is all man’s doing; it is not when God says in the scriptures that he will put the people in the land.

“And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle”: the way these locusts fly, they sound like many chariots running to battle. The Red Baron clip showed the World War I planes with double wings, the faces of men and the scarves. In World War I the guns were not in the front, because shooting from the front damaged the propellers; the movie is Hollywood.

“And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails”: the tail gunner or rear gunner sat in the back of the plane like a scorpion. “And their power was to hurt men five months”: five years.

“And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit”: the messenger of Europe. Kaiser Wilhelm II, the last German Emperor and King of Prussia, initiated World War I; he reigned from 1888 until his abdication on 9 November 1918, shortly before Germany’s defeat. “Whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon”: the same meaning, destroyer, but two different names. Some Israelites say your name cannot translate into another language; this tells you a name does change in another language.

“One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter”: write this down, the next woe is recorded in Revelation 11:14 and the next in Revelation 12:12. Arthur Koestler, of the people that call themselves Jewish, researched his lineage and wrote The Thirteenth Tribe in 1976. Its thesis is that the Ashkenazi Jews are not descended from the historical Israelites of antiquity, but from the Khazars, a Turkic people who converted to Judaism in the 8th century, during the Dark Ages, and migrated westwards into Eastern Europe in the 12th and 13th centuries as the Khazar empire collapsed. The Khazars are the clifts of the rocks we read about in Job 30, the Caucasus mountains. These are the people the Balfour Declaration was about, and that set up the State of Israel on 14 May 1948; this all connects. Look for the early editions; the new editions took things out.

“Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates”: the Euphrates is one of the rivers mentioned in Genesis 2. It goes through Baghdad, from Iraq near Kuwait up through Syria towards Turkey.

“Which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year”: a particular hour, on a particular day, a particular month and a particular year. “For to slay the third part of men”: the third part of men is the sons of the wicked; that is their purpose. God created these four and bound them there, set up just for that region, like the demon Asmodeus that was bound in Egypt in Tobit.

“And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand”: this is not one military, it is multitudes of militaries together prepared for battle. An article on the world’s biggest armies listed China, the USA, India, North Korea, Russia, Pakistan, South Korea, Iran, Turkey and Vietnam by active personnel.

“And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire”: these are the weapons, the military instruments, their tanks, their planes, their missiles. “And the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions”: meaning they had power, and they made a sound. “And out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone”: he is describing missiles.
